name: Toggle

props.name: defaultToggled
props.description: Specify whether the toggle should be on by default

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: If true, the side labels (props.labelA and props.labelB) will be replaced by props.labelText (if passed), so that the toggle doesn't render a top label.

props.name: labelA
props.description: Specify the label for the "off" position

props.name: labelB
props.description: Specify the label for the "on" position

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control. This should be provided unless 'aria-labelledby' is set instead or you use an external <label> element with its "for" attribute set to the toggle's id.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the toggle should be read-only

props.name: size
props.description: Provide an event listener that is called when the control is toggled / onToggle?(checked: boolean): void; /** Specify the size of the Toggle. Currently only supports 'sm' or 'md' (default)

props.name: toggled
props.description: Specify whether the control is toggled

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Toggle rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
